name: Heal
description: Directly increase a unit's current health, capped at maximum health; negative heal values deal no damage and cannot kill.
game_hints: 'Recently Healed' debuff (35 s) halves subsequent summoner Heal effects
healing restored below 20 HP is not shown as the +X green text
leveling up and max-health increases also raise current health but are NOT considered healing
{tip|healing} status template; heal is modified by Grievous Wounds and healing amplifiers

name: Heal and shield power
description: Champion stat that additively increases the effectiveness of self and outgoing heals and shields.
game_hints: affects self heals, self shields, outgoing heals/shields and drain; NOT incoming heals/shields, life steal, vamp, health regen, or bonus health (per {Healing modifiers} matrix)
stacks additively with itself but multiplicatively with other heal modifiers
granted by items (Dawncore, Diadem of Songs, Whispering Circlet), rune Revitalize (5%), Yuumi You and Me!, neutral buff Chemtech Blight

name: Heal amplification
description: Multiplicative modifiers that increase healing effectiveness (healing received or outgoing), separate from heal and shield power.
game_hints: Spirit Visage passive 'Boundless Vitality' (+25%) multiplies the life steal/omnivamp stat value itself, not just healing
Immortal Path amplifies healing below 50% health; Revitalize adds 10% healing increase (5% below 40% health)
Aatrox World Ender, Briar Crimson Curse, Trundle Frozen Domain, Nilah Joy Unending also amplify healing

name: Health regeneration
description: Passive restoration of current health over time (stat per 5 s, ticking in 0.5 s intervals, disabled at full health).
game_hints: considered healing only for healing modifiers and end-of-game 'Healing Done' tracking
reduced by Grievous Wounds; amplified by Spirit Visage/Immortal Path; NOT by Revitalize or heal and shield power
sources: fountain, Health Relic, potions (Health Potion, Refillable Potion, Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will), Warmog's Armor, Doran's Shield, Second Wind, Biscuit Delivery, Crest of Cinders

name: Health threshold
description: Restricts a unit so its health cannot exceed a set maximum via healing or health regeneration; current health is reduced to the threshold if above it.
game_hints: applied by K'Sante All Out

name: Grey health
description: Health-bar storage of recently taken damage that designated champion abilities convert into healing.
game_hints: appears dark grey between current health and shields; not counted by health-based effects
users: Dr. Mundo (Heart Zapper), Locke (Soul Ignition), Pyke (Gift of the Drowned Ones), Rengar (Battle Roar), Tahm Kench (Thick Skin)

name: Max health increase restores current health
description: Increasing a unit's maximum health raises its current health by the same amount; this is not considered healing and ignores healing reduction.
game_hints: leveling up and abilities like Lulu Wild Growth raise current health with max health but bypass healing modifiers
a decrease in max health does not lower current health unless it would exceed the new maximum

name: Overheal
description: Conversion of healing in excess of maximum health into a temporary shield (Overheal rune, removed in V14.10).
game_hints: life steal, omnivamp and physical vamp apply Overheal; health regeneration does not
shield scaled with 11% maximum health at removal; decayed 2.5% of max shield per second after 6 s
replaced by rune Absorb Life (V14.10); shield VFX file 'Overheal shield VFX.png'

name: Life steal
description: Stat granting healing equal to a percentage of post-mitigation basic damage dealt (basic attacks and abilities tagged as basic damage).
game_hints: does not benefit from heal and shield power; stacks additively; reduced by Grievous Wounds
applies to post-mitigation damage; item on-hit effects tagged via {tip info|Applies lifesteal}
Spirit Visage 'Boundless Vitality' multiplies the life steal stat itself (10% * 1.25 = 12.5%)
no effect vs structures; effectively 0 vs wards (damage reduced to 1)

name: Omnivamp
description: Stat granting healing equal to a percentage of post-mitigation physical, magic and true damage dealt; reduced to 33% effectiveness vs minions/monsters for AoE, pet and damage-over-time sources.
game_hints: does not apply to Ignite or Smite damage (since V26.04)
does not benefit from heal and shield power; stacks additively; reduced by Grievous Wounds
33% AoE/pet penalty vs minions/monsters since V26.01 (previously 20%); V14.1 removed AoE/pet penalty entirely

name: Physical vamp
description: Archived stat subtype of vamp granting healing equal to a percentage of post-mitigation physical damage dealt; no current sources since V11.13.
game_hints: stat removed from the HUD in V14.1; last source Sanguine Blade removed V11.13
does not benefit from heal and shield power; still listed in {Healing modifiers} matrix as affected by Spirit Visage, Revitalize, Grievous Wounds

name: Spell vamp
description: Archived stat subtype of vamp granting healing equal to a percentage of post-mitigation ability damage dealt; no sources left since V26.04.
game_hints: last source Lee Sin Iron Will removed V26.04
does not benefit from heal and shield power; proc, default and basic damage do not benefit from spell vamp
historically 33% effectiveness for area and pet damage (removed V14.1)

name: Drain
description: Unofficial category of effects that heal based on damage dealt (post- or pre-mitigation) and benefit from heal and shield power.
game_hints: post-mitigation drain: Aatrox Deathbringer Stance, Aphelios Severum, Briar Snack Attack, Warwick Eternal Hunger, Conqueror, Elixir of Wrath, Knight's Vow; pre-mitigation: Briar Crimson Curse, Fiddlesticks Bountiful Harvest, Vladimir Sanguine Pool
drain effects have no AoE penalty unless stated; all benefit from heal and shield power (unlike vamp stats)

name: Vamp
description: Umbrella category of stats that heal based on damage dealt, regrouping omnivamp, physical vamp, spell vamp and drain.
game_hints: {tip|Reactive damage} (Bramble Vest, Thornmail) does not benefit from any vamp
Vampirism is a removed mastery that granted life steal and spell vamp (archival link)

name: Shield
description: Temporary hit-points that absorb damage in place of health; resistances still mitigate first, strength scales with heal and shield power, and Grievous Wounds does not reduce shields.
game_hints: shielded damage is separate from health for health-based (current/max/missing) effects
most shields appear as a buff on the status bar; shield color on health bar indicates type
not to be confused with {tip|Spell shield} (spell negation) or visual-only shields like Leona Eclipse
Barrier and Unleashed Teleport (Toplane Quest) summoner spells create shields

name: Normal shield
description: Shield that absorbs all damage types (physical, magic, true), displayed greyish-white on the health bar.
game_hints: health-bar color #C0C0C0 greyish-white; includes Locket of the Iron Solari, Guardian, Summon Aery, Bloodthirster, Sterak's Gage, Fimbulwinter

name: Magic shield
description: Shield that only absorbs magic damage, displayed purple on the health bar.
game_hints: users: Morgana Black Shield, Galio Hero's Entrance/Shield of Durand, Kassadin Null Sphere; items Hexdrinker, Kaenic Rookern, Maw of Malmortius, Chainlaced Crushers

name: Physical shield
description: Shield that only absorbs physical damage, displayed orange on the health bar.
game_hints: users: Camille Adaptive Defenses (physical mode), item Armored Advance

name: Shield reduction
description: Effects that reduce the strength of shields granted to a unit (Serpent's Fang; does not apply to magic damage shields).
game_hints: Serpent's Fang is the only current source; per {Healing modifiers} matrix it affects self shields and incoming shields only

name: Shield destruction
description: Effects that fully destroy any shields before applying their damage, even when the damage would be blocked by a spell shield.
game_hints: sources: executes, Blitzcrank Static Field, Rell Shattering Strike, empowered Renekton Ruthless Predator

name: Shield stacking priority
description: When multiple shields are active, damage is absorbed by the shield expiring soonest, except Camille Adaptive Defenses and Morgana Black Shield which take priority.
game_hints: Camille Adaptive Defenses and Morgana Black Shield absorb damage before all other shields

name: On-heal effect
description: Effects that trigger upon healing or being healed by an ally (Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water, Summon Aery, etc.).
game_hints: triggers: Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water, Summon Aery, Echoes of Helia, Diadem of Songs, Crimson Lucidity, Lucian Vigilance (Lightslinger), Nilah Joy Unending

name: On-shield effect
description: Effects that trigger upon shielding or being shielded by an ally (same item/rune family as on-heal effects).
game_hints: triggers: Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water, Summon Aery, Echoes of Helia, Diadem of Songs, Crimson Lucidity, Lucian Vigilance, Nilah Joy Unending

name: Healing reduction
description: Modifiers that reduce all healing and health regeneration a unit receives (Grievous Wounds 40%; also Howling Abyss aura 50% outgoing, Sion Glory in Death 100% incoming).
game_hints: {tip|Howling Abyss aura} reduces all outgoing healing effects by 50%
Sion Glory in Death reduces incoming healing that is not life steal or spell vamp by 100%
Mutilator was Aatrox's old self-heal/shield reduction debuff (40%) — trivia
reduces health regeneration too; does not affect shields

name: Grievous Wounds
description: Named debuff status that reduces all healing and health regeneration received by 40%; does not stack (refreshes) and does not affect shields.
game_hints: applied by Ignite, Bramble Vest, Thornmail, Executioner's Calling, Mortal Reminder, Chempunk Chainsword, Oblivion Orb, Morellonomicon, Katarina Death Lotus, Varus Hail of Arrows, Singed Poison Trail (during Insanity Potion)
dispelled by resurrection effects, Sion Glory in Death, and death ({tip|dispel})
damage-dependent sources apply GW even if damage was fully mitigated by a shield (since V13.7)
standard effect 40% since V13.3; enhanced 60% variant removed

name: Healing negation
description: Effects that prevent a unit from being healed altogether once a condition is met (Kindred Lamb's Respite health threshold).
game_hints: Kindred Lamb's Respite negates all healing on a unit once they reach a certain health threshold

name: Revive
description: Return a dead unit to life at a location (summoner spell Revive — removed V5.4; resurrection-status effects still exist in game).
game_hints: {tip|resurrection} and {tip|zombie state} statuses; resurrection clears Grievous Wounds via dispel
Revive summoner spell respawned the champion at home base with a decaying speed boost; converted to Soul Anchor trinket in Dominion
resurrection/zombie-state heals after fatal damage are unaffected by healing modifiers
